environment.os: Ubuntu 22.04 under WSL; Windows CPU analysis

title: GOOSE failure causes: attention context intervention and low-rock geometry association
dataset: GOOSE 3D base validation, challenge labels v1.1; January Aying Mangfall scene
sensor_configuration: VLS128 LiDAR; single-scan PTv3 predictions; no radar
annotation_schema: Fine semantic labels remapped to eight challenge classes; sky 8 mapped to other 0 as original loader
split: Post-hoc frames 0496, 0497 and 0498; three adjacent frames, 644654 points; not an independent benchmark
model: Published challenge PTv3 epoch 33; same checkpoint, FP32, flash-off, single augmentation; patch64/repeat/128/256
commands: Run the four fresh Pointcept configurations documented in docs/goose-failure-causes.md

notes: Bounded diagnosis completed. Fresh patch64 baseline repeat is prediction-identical. Only saved-config differences are output path and attention patch sizes. Larger context reduces pooled ground confusion but correct rock category remains poor and some individual frames worsen. Ground-height proxies and visible snow do not prove a causal geometry/weather effect. Original patch64 eight-scenario evidence is retained. No default runtime change, training, full-split or radar comparison.
